convert_waymo_to_kitti: create a Waymo2KITTI converter instance and call convert to transform tfrecord files to KITTI format
convert_single_waymo_file: build a Waymo2KITTI converter and call convert_one with a file index to process a single tfrecord
save_waymo_lidar_point_cloud: use save_lidar to parse range images and save 6-dimensional point cloud data as binary files
save_waymo_calibration: call save_calib to extract camera intrinsic and extrinsic parameters and save them in KITTI calib format
convert_cartesian_to_homogeneous: call cart_to_homo to convert a 3x3 or 3x4 Cartesian transformation matrix to 4x4 homogeneous format
